entities.title: Lockstep
entities.summary: Browsers play the same steps, notice drift, and agree on who left.
criteria: Browsers play the same steps whatever the delays
A player who leaves plays on as null from the same step for everyone
Browsers notice when their games drift apart
The delay covers the slowest two players' connections

entities.title: Names
entities.summary: Names are cleaned to what the game's font can draw, up to 12 characters.
criteria: Accents are dropped and a few letters spelled out (Þórður becomes Thordur)
Markup characters are removed, and a name with no letter or digit is empty
Every character of a cleaned name has a glyph in the game's font
